title: Ascent and descent of bounded linear operators
summary: Let $\mathcal B(\mathcal X)$ be the algebra of all bounded linear operators on a real or complex Banach space $\mathcal{X}$ with $\dim\mathcal X \ge 3$. In this paper, we first explore the ascent (descent) of upper triangular block operator matrices and certain special algebraic operators, and then establish characterizations for the ascent (descent) of rank-one and rank-two operators. Based on these results, we characterize features for some special operators by the ascent (descent) of Jordan products.
